title: Юная волшебница Лалабель: Отдых на море
originalTitle: Mahô shôjo Lalabelle: Umi ga yobu natsuyatsumi
alt: Юная волшебница Лалабель (фильм) / Юная волшебница Лалабель: Отдых на море / Magical Girl Lalabel: the Sea Calls for a Summer Vacation /  Mahou Shoujo Lalabel (1980) / Mahou Shoujo Lalabel: Umi ga Yobu Natsuyasumi 魔法少女ララベル (1980)
description: История о юной волшебнице Лалабель, которая живет в мире магии.

en:
During the summer, Lalabel and her friends, Teko and Toko, arrived at the hostel owned by Teko's uncle. Teko's uncle and aunt have gone to the operation of their acquiantance, leaving their son, Ryota, to manage the hostel all by himself. Lalabel decides to help the boy out and together, all of them become involved in the management of the hostel.



(Source: Anime News Network)
